about.summary: Each point is one face image, encoded by a StyleGAN2 trained with an encoder on CelebA and FFHQ. 2,000 CelebA test images, 1,000 with and 1,000 without the 'Male' attribute.

sections.title: Source
items: CelebA (Liu et al. 2015): celebrity face images with 40 binary attributes annotated per image.
The model was trained on CelebA and FFHQ (Karras et al. 2019) together.

sections.title: Model
items: StyleGAN2 trained with an encoder (after Adversarial Latent Autoencoders, Pidhorskyi et al. 2020): the discriminator is split into an encoder and a small classifier, and a consistency loss makes the encoder map a generated image back to the latent vector it was generated from.
Each image is encoded to one latent vector (one point per image), projected with UMAP; the UMAP parameters were not recorded.

sections.title: Colour options
items: The 40 CelebA attributes, e.g. Male, Black_Hair, Eyeglasses: 1 = present, -1 = absent, as annotated in CelebA.

sections.title: Caveats
items: CelebA attributes were annotated by people and are subjective for several of them (e.g. Attractive).
